title: Dappled Forest Drop
description: Adding the upcoming Dappled Forest update earlier alongside the Poplar Wood set, Abandoned Camp, and more!
body:
## The Dappled Forest sounded cool, so I made it earlier than Mojang!
### Uses Fabric API

This mod is the upcoming Dappled Forest update (for presumably 26.3) this Summer.
The update includes:
- **Dappled Forest Biome**
- **Poplar Wood Set (w/ 3 leaf colors)**
- **Abandoned Camp**
- **Wool stairs & slabs**
- **and more!**

I'm really proud of this mod even if it doesn't look like much - and I hope you like it too!
